FN-3K6KEVE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 390
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 390 as introduced would transfer certain responsibilities regarding the licensure and
regulation of the cultivation of cannabis from the Alabama Department of Agriculture and
Industries (AGI) to the Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission (AMCC) which would increase
the obligations of the AMCC by an estimated $195,000 annually to inspect culivators and
correspondingly dcrease the obligations of the AGI by an estimated $195,000 annually.
Page 1

FN-3K6KEVE-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 390
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation & Forestry Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/30/2024
House Bill 390 as passed the House of Representatives would transfer certain responsibilities
regarding the licensure and regulation of the cultivation of cannabis from the Alabama
Department of Agriculture and Industries (AGI) to the Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission
(AMCC) which would increase the obligations of the AMCC by an estimated $195,000 annually
to inspect cultivators and correspondingly decrease the obligations of the AGI by an estimated
$195,000 annually.
